lanes.title: Add service-role provider dispatch preflight with Xometry compatibility
lanes.description: PR #574 (stacked on #573/OVD-458 and #571/OVD-536). Linear OVD-459: one service-only preflight (migration 20261003170000 #136, public.api_authorize_provider_worker_dispatch, service_role-only, read-only) returns a bounded, versioned authorization decision (provider-dispatch-authorization.v1) for the exact current task/lane/permit/provider/session/files/scope or a stable terminal denial; a narrow compatibility path returns the Xometry preflight verbatim for Xometry scopes; worker/src/providerDispatchPreflight.ts is the strict consumer that only calls an adapter after an admitted decision. The branch ALSO carries, merged forward from today's work, migrations 137 (OVD-598 legacy NOWAIT admission), 138 (OVD-601 empty upload rejection) and 139 (OVD-628 generic NOWAIT admission) with their suites, pins (full139) and client changes: those were verified and merged under their own issues and are NOT re-reviewed here except for consistency of the combined profile pins and the final diff. The OVD-459 acceptance criteria are binding.
acceptance: Preflight reauthorizes the exact current task immediately before execution and returns no authority for stale, revoked, disabled, malformed or mismatched state (pgTAP: one assertion per denial code; the static migration test enforces that every emitted code is in the vocabulary).
Cross-provider, file, derivative, scope, session, organization, task/lane, permit, policy and envelope substitution fails closed (pgTAP and worker spy tests with zero adapter calls).
Missing permits on internal/service-created tasks produce no runnable authorization (permit_state_missing).
The bounded response exposes no credentials, customer file content, private policy rows or unrestricted evidence (exact key-set assertions).
Only documented transient service unavailability is retryable (preflight_unavailable on the worker side only; every database denial retryable:false; preflight_rejected terminal for other SQLSTATEs).

Existing Xometry worker preflight fixtures and payload/fingerprint behavior remain compatible (byte parity ::text for authorized, stale-scope and unknown-task cases; quoteWithDispatchPreflight and the legacy RPC untouched).
Generalized preflight can be disabled (revoke execute from service_role) while the specialized Xometry path remains available (pgTAP).

Clock re-sampled after every lock; documented lock order (task and permit FOR UPDATE, then result/request/job FOR SHARE, then parts/requirements/files FOR SHARE in issuance order, then registry/envelope rows FOR SHARE, then shared advisory locks); cancellation and revocation races (lock-barrier pgTAP) end with no 40P01; mutation evidence (request lock removed fails the cancellation race; clock re-sample removed fails the expiry race).

Combined profile: full139 pins (134 OVD-536, 135 OVD-458, 136 OVD-459, 137 OVD-598, 138 OVD-601, 139 OVD-628) consistent in scripts/free-quote-ci-profile.mjs, the source fixture, the node test, the workflow label and the packet doc; fixture --check and migration lineage pass; hosted free-quote-sql green at the head.

Hosted checks green at the head; Sonar new issues on changed lines dispositioned (expect a large count from the mandated restates); CodeRabbit/Codex threads at the head resolved or dispositioned; the PR body names the actual final head, the full stack state and the carried 137-139 content.
